artworks.title: A Flying Angel
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, heightened with white, over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a human figure with wings positioned as though in flight. The figure is captured from a slightly frontal perspective, with the head turned downwards and the right arm outstretched. The facial features are undefined, focusing more on the body's muscular structure. The figure wears a cloth or drapery around the waist and has well-defined muscles on the chest, arms, and legs. Large wings extend out behind the figure, adding to the sense of flight. The background is plain with a light texture.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Young Man with a Skull
artworks.description: The image depicts an individual holding a human skull and pointing towards it. The person has detailed eyes, curly hair, and wears elaborate clothing with a large feathered hat. The background consists of closely spaced horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Herdsmen Crossing a Waterfall
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper, with later framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a stream and a rustic bridge. In the background, there are hills and trees. Two children are near the water, one fishing and the other standing. The bridge is old and covered with vegetation. Farm animals and figures are visible beyond the bridge. The artist's style includes intricate strokes for movement and texture, with a focus on foliage and water. The color palette is mostly red and ochre. Trees with detailed leaves frame the scene, leading the eye to a clear sky.

artworks.title: Seneca Standing in the Bath
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a large bathtub. He is standing with his upper body and legs visible, one arm slightly raised and the other relaxed by his side. The man has prominent facial features, short curly hair, and a beard. He is wearing a cloth around his waist. The bathtub has a decorative lion's head with a ring in its mouth. In the background, there is an arched architectural structure.

artworks.title: Judith Beheading Holofernes
artworks.artist: Cornelis Galle I after Sir Peter Paul Rubens

artworks.title: The Fall of the Rebel Angels
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to platemark): 56.7 × 43.3 cm (22 5/16 × 17 1/16 in.)
mount: 6.8 × 48 cm (2 11/16 × 18 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a black-and-white print depicting a celestial battle between angelic and monstrous figures. The central figure is a winged being in armor holding a circular shield, surrounded by other angels. Below them are intertwined monstrous creatures with animalistic features like wings and horns. The figures are all falling over one another, limbs tangled and overlapping.

artworks.title: The Fall of the Rebel Angels
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a black-and-white print depicting a celestial battle between angelic and monstrous figures. The central figure is a winged being in armor holding a circular shield, surrounded by other angels. Below them are intertwined, monstrous creatures with animalistic features like wings and horns. The figures are all falling over one another, limbs tangled and overlapping.

artworks.title: Saint Francis Receiving the Stigmata
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman (artist and publisher), after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a religious figure meeting a celestial being. The scene suggests a moment of divine revelation or spiritual vision, with a robed man kneeling and looking up at an angelic figure glowing with light. Another figure is lying on the ground, shielding their eyes. The setting includes rocks, trees, and underbrush, highlighting the contrast between the divine light and earthly elements.

artworks.title: Saint Simon
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a person standing in a three-quarter pose. The person has one arm resting on their hip and the other arm raised, holding a long staff. The facial features are minimally detailed, and they have long, flowing hair. They are wearing a loose robe that drapes around their body. The background consists of simple hatching and lines, with the person's figure as the central focus. No accessories or additional objects are visible.

artworks.title: Saint Simon
artworks.description: This is a painting of an aged figure in a flowing robe holding a tablet overhead. The figure is seated. The artwork is rendered in earthy tones with a textured surface. The figure's expression is solemn, and the drapery of the robe is detailed. The piece captures a dramatic use of light and shadow typical of Rembrandt's work.

artworks.title: The Elevation of the Cross
artworks.artist: Jan Witdoeck after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: A group of muscular men lift a cross onto which a man has been nailed in this long engraving, which is printed with fine black lines and shading on three joined sheets of off-white paper. The bearded person on the cross, Jesus, is also muscular and wears only a loincloth across his hips. A ring of thorns is thrust onto his head, and he looks up. Eight men struggle to raise the cross, and one of them pulls on a rope tied to the crossbeam. Muscles bulge across the backs of two bare-chested men on our side of the wooden cross. Two of the others are also shirtless. Two wear armor, and the final two men wear long-sleeved robes. Three women, two children, and a dog cluster in the lower right corner on the right sheet. A woman and a clean-shaven man stand behind them, and they all look on with mouths open or lips downturned. Six people look on from behind and around the opening of a deep cave behind the standing man and woman. Four men are on horseback to our left. Three wear helmets, and one of those looks out at us. The bareheaded man gestures toward Jesus with a scepter. Men nail the hands of another person to a wooden cross in the background to the left, and a bound man is led to our right. Clouds streak across the sky over a town in the distance. Inscriptions printed below the image in the lower left margin reads, “PP Rubens pinxit, H. Withouc sculpsit Ao 1638.” Text printed under the center of the image reads, “D CORNELIO VANDER GEEST VIRORVM OPTIMO ET AMICORVM VETVSTISSIMO SVOQVE AB ADOLESCENTIA PERPETVO FAVTORI ATRISQVE PICTORIAE SVMMO DVM VIXIT ADMIRATORI MONVMENTVM HOC ATERNAE AMICATIAE QVOD SVPERSTITIT DESTINARAT DEFVNCTO L.M.D.D.Q. Ex Tabula Walburgensis Ecclesiae cuius ipse praecipuus Author et prmotor fuit.” An inscription in the lower right margin reads, “Cum priuilegiis Regis Christianissimi Principum Belgaruin et Ordinum Batauiae.”

artworks.title: Wild Boar
artworks.medium: red chalk over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This image shows a wild boar lying down. The drawing depicts the wild boar resting on a textured surface. It is executed in a monochrome sepia or reddish-brown tone, using shading and line work to convey fur and ground textures. There is handwritten script at the top which reads: "Wildschwein im Lager."

artworks.title: The Bohemians Marching: The Vanguard
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on gold colored silk
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. David Tunick in memory of Allison Hope Tunick
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a caravan of travelers and animals in motion. The composition features a line of riders on horses and camels, some of which are draped in flowing garments, while the animals carry packs or additional figures. The scene showcases a detailed, linear style with figures carrying staffs or spears. The upper left corner of the image contains text in French. Despite the monochrome palette, the intricate linework and shading convey movement and atmosphere.

artworks.title: Gericault
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. David Tunick
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the shoulders up in a three-quarter position facing slightly to the right. The man has distinct facial features including a pointed beard and mustache, sharp eyebrows, and neatly combed hair. He wears a small hat with a decorative detail, a collared garment, and a cravat tied in a decorative manner. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Satyr Holding a Roundel
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure's upper half, including the torso and part of the head. The person is shown in a reclining position, with the torso twisted and head turned upwards to the side. The facial features are sketched with eyes, nose, and mouth visible, along with stylized hair or headgear. The figure appears unclothed, with no visible clothing details. Light sketching is shown around the figure, possibly hinting at faint outlines of other elements. The background is plain with the texture of the paper and scattered specks.

artworks.title: The Partridge Saves Her Young
artworks.medium: brush and black ink, white gouache, and gray wash, with a simluated mount in blue and gray wash and pen and dark brown ink, on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a dog hunting in a landscape with a bridge over a river and rolling lands. In the background, there is a structure resembling a castle or house on a promontory, under a cloudy sky. The scene includes tall grass and reeds in the foreground, with a monochromatic palette of blues and grays creating a metallic look. The painting features detailed natural and architectural elements using fine brushstrokes, with a deep blue frame.

artworks.title: The Skeletons
artworks.description: The image shows a group of curving and jagged lines that intersect, creating an abstract composition resembling a craggy landscape. Among the forms are elements reminiscent of natural scenes like trees and rocks. Some shapes resemble water, foliage, and figures. The lines convey motion and texture, suggesting natural forces at play in the depiction.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Arch
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a sculpted bust on the left, architectural ruins and arches in the background, and a figure holding foliage in the mid-ground. The color palette is monochrome, mainly black, white, and gray. The bust is on a pedestal on the left with tall plumes and floral decorations. A figure stands in the middle with the arch framing the scene. The foreground has broken sculptures and organic materials like leaves and flowers scattered intricately.

artworks.title: The Tomb of Nero
artworks.description: The view shows an overgrown ancient ruin surrounded by vegetation. The horizon is unclear, with intricate etching details blurring the boundaries between layers of the landscape. In the distance, there are faint outlines of trees against a cloudy sky. The image features fine etching strokes creating a rich texture, emphasizing carvings on the stonework and surrounding vegetation. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white. Snakes, foliage, and ruins are intertwined in the foreground, with plant life seemingly cascading over the structure's edges. The composition guides the eye through layers of architecture and nature towards the background.

artworks.title: The Monumental Tablet
artworks.description: The image displays a collection of skeletal remains, ornate flourishes, and architectural elements. In the center, there is a swirling pattern dominating the composition. The artwork is monochromatic, with detailed linework and shading providing contrast. At the bottom center, several skulls and bones are visible, while an elaborately decorated column with garlands and medallions is on the left. The right side features skeletal forms blending into a pattern of plumes and scrolls, creating a sense of flow and movement.

artworks.title: The Partridge and the Cocks
artworks.medium: brush and black ink, gray wash, and white gouache on blue laid paper//royal blue wash border
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a rustic hut, a tree, and a wooden fence. The background features a sketched forest with treetops. The brushstrokes create texture in the trees and birds. The color palette consists mainly of blue shades.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dedication scene. It shows two figures seated outdoors, gesturing towards a large, inscribed panel. The figures wear elaborate clothing, with one in a feathered hat. The inscription on the panel dedicates to Sir Joshua Reynolds from J. H. Mortimer in 1778. The surrounding scenery includes tree trunks, foliage, and detailed textures and shading. The style is intricate and precise, resembling an 18th-century etching or engraving.

artworks.title: Pastoral
artworks.description: The engraving depicts two individuals, a man and a woman, partially visible from the knees up, seated on a grassy ledge surrounded by natural scenery. The woman is sitting on the right side with one leg up, leaning back towards the man, who is reclined next to her. Her facial features are soft and her expression is relaxed, with her hair styled in loose curls adorned with a wreath of leaves. She is wearing a flowing robe or dress. The man is dressed in a vest with sleeves and has curly hair, also adorned with a leafy headdress. A sheep is reclining in front of them, and a basket is to their left. The background features detailed foliage, trees, and a view of the sky with wispy clouds.

artworks.title: Jealous Monster
artworks.description: This is a drawing of fantastical creatures in turmoil. The composition shows two monstrous figures engaged in a dynamic struggle or embrace. The figures are depicted with exaggerated facial features and muscular forms. The drawing uses detailed line work to create texture and depth, especially in the hair and water. A third monstrous head appears in the water in the foreground. The background includes swirling clouds and a partial view of landscape elements. At the bottom, the text "JEALOUS MONSTER" is featured.
